recap.text: Donut glows bright red while Carl is still asking whether the boxes are custom tailored. Mordecai activates her menus, and five boxes line up: three bronze ones with healing potions and torches, a silver one with a book and a pile of pet biscuits, and a legendary one with a single small, jeweled tiara. The book is the Tome of Magic Missile, which Mordecai says teaches a spell permanently, where scrolls cast it once.

beats.headline: Taught herself already
beats.text: Mordecai activates Donut's menus, and five boxes line up in front of her: three bronze ones with a couple of healing potions and torches, then a silver adventurer box holding a book and a pile of pet biscuits. The note over the book reads Tome of Magic Missile. The legendary box holds a single small, jeweled tiara. While Carl asks whether boxes are custom tailored, Donut glows a bright red. Ah, Princess Donut, says Mordecai, I see you taught yourself the Magic Missile spell already. Tomes permanently teach you the spell; scrolls just cast it once.
beats.gist: Mordecai activates Donut's menus, and her five boxes include a Tome of Magic Missile, which Donut already knows.
